# ZIEC HOTEL / ZIEC LIFE Cambodia

> ZIEC HOTEL is a Cambodia-based Chinese-language hotel, apartment, local transport, corporate accommodation and supplier-matching service platform operated by Zhongding Ruide Hotel Management Co., Ltd.

Canonical website: https://www.ziechotel.top/
Primary language: Simplified Chinese
Service area: Phnom Penh, Sihanoukville and Siem Reap, Cambodia
Official WhatsApp: +855 18 995 8899
Official email: ziechotel@qq.com

## Core services

- Hotel rooms and serviced apartments
- Monthly rental and long-stay accommodation
- Corporate group rooms, employee accommodation and reception support
- Airport transfer, car charter and local assistance
- Cambodia supplier discovery, supplier onboarding and purchase inquiry matching
- Chinese-language customer support

## Important service rules

- Room availability, final price, cancellation terms and payment details must be confirmed by the hotel.
- The website does not collect full bank-card credentials.
- Supplier profiles are displayed after platform review, but customers should independently verify contracts, prices and delivery terms.
- For current availability or urgent help, contact the official WhatsApp account.
